visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Group options with optgroup
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A long list of countries mixes two continents. Group the options with optgroup and a label for each continent. The options and their values must stay the same.

solution.code:
<select id="c">
  <optgroup label="Europe">
    <option value="fr">France</option>
    <option value="de">Germany</option>
  </optgroup>
  <optgroup label="Asia">
    <option value="jp">Japan</option>
    <option value="in">India</option>
  </optgroup>
</select>
solution.explanation: optgroup shows headings inside the list without changing the options. Users scan a grouped list faster, and the values that the form sends are the same.

checks.label: The values are fr, de, jp and in
